'''Togepi's Determination''' (Japanese: '''トゲピーの重大決心''' ''{{tt|Togepy|Togepi}}'s Serious Determination'') is the eighty-fifth chapter of the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
While still at Goldenrod City, Red meets the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman of Johto. The Chairman notices Red's Togepi and is interested in having it. With Togepi having a new training partner, will this be goodbye for Togepi?

==Major events==
* {{PPM|Red}} trades his {{TP|Red|Togepi}} for the Pokémon Fan Club Chairman's {{TP|Red|Tyrogue}}.

===Debuts===

====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Tyrogue}} ({{OP|Red|Tyrogue}})

==Trivia==
* The trade that Red did with the Chairman is similar to the one that happened in the games at the Goldenrod Department Store where the Pokémon received is a {{type|Fighting}}. However, the one in the games is a {{p|Machop|different Pokémon}}.
